Independently computed signed 11x5 Morse boundary columns: c1=(row4+row6), c2=c3=-(row5), c4=-c1, c5=row5. Rank two primitive image with minor +/-1 gives H7=Z9,H8=Z3; because wedge 7-skeleton simply connected and pi7 is free on generators, unimodular cancellation yields wedge of spheres.
